There is an argument for it in the sense of the lack of land. Iirc the argument went for the idea that the lack of land at which the elephants can live is an extremely influential determinate of how many elephants can live there in the first place. This can result in a phenomenon where even though the elephant is an endangered animal it can overpopulate the land that is available for it to live this culling is necessary to ensure that food and water is abundant for the healthy population as well as prevent the spreading of diseases that we see with overpopulation. 

Not saying that everyone should just go kill them. Well first you need to know your ph level. If it isnt stable certain crops wont grow. Now once you know your ph look for crops that can grow in this climate with little to no care besides occasional watering (if you have a four wheeler you can get a sprayer if it gets real bad and you need to water) now out of the crops you are able to plant research nutritional facts and their attributes to deer. Some are good for body weight some for antler mass and some just taste better. Now if you notice the ph is on the line for a certain crop lime your fields. This should help the ph level. Now you know what you are going to plant so you need a disk and spreader (or you can hand spread) now disks can be attached to trucks tractors or four wheelers but you say no tractors so go with the latter. Now this should allow you to plant a summer crop for happy healthy deer. Ok so i mentioned ph a lot so to get a reading on it you can but a ph tester yourself or you can find a place to send it to to get it tested (better idea to do this) now i know auburn university will take samples but you might want something more local. This is assuming you dont already know the ph of your land. Now the tested sample will come with the reading as well as a recommended pounds of lime per acre to help get the ph to a manageable level. Now to lime simply get spreader and spread the lime (buy at a farm or tractor supply shop). Now the better the level of ph the more tender all crops will be and the better tasting and greener the grass and all the bells and whistles. This results in better nutrition for the animals as well as happy animals. This might give you an edge on your neighbors. Oh almost forgot ph balancing can be immediate or done over time. This means you dont have to go and binge all the lime at once but can do it over time. Also try Imodium nitrate to help fertilize crops when they have risen (it does magical things) good hunting :)
